question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

In this engineering design project you will learn how to build an infinity mirror, with built-in lights that make the mirror look like a deep ______ with no end.
solution:
The appropriate word to fill in the blank is **"tunnel."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "tunnel" fits the blank because it aligns with the concept of an "infinity mirror" that creates the illusion of depth with no end.
 
• An infinity mirror consists of parallel mirrors with LED lights placed between them, creating a visually appealing effect of infinite reflections.
 
• When the lights are turned on, it gives the illusion of a tunnel or corridor extending infinitely into the distance.

Therefore, the correct answer is: In this engineering design project you will learn how to build an infinity mirror, with built-in lights that make the mirror look like a deep ***tunnel __***with no end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Now, let's provide the meanings of all the options along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Tunnel: **An underground passage or hollow through a hill, beneath a city, or under a building, typically with a roadway or railway track inside. (सुरंग)
 
• **Lodge:** A small house or cottage, typically located in a rural or remote area. It can also refer to a local branch of a society or organization. (छोटा घर)
 
• **Funeral:** A ceremony or service held shortly after a person's death, typically including the burial or cremation of the body. (अंतिम संस्कार)
 
• **Signal:** A gesture, action, or sound used to convey information or indicate a command or warning. It can also refer to a device or system that sends out electrical or radio waves to communicate information. (संकेत)
